endorsements.name: Krugov Aryom
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-10551
endorsements.description: The Sticky Social Icons WordPress plugin through 1.2.1 does not sanitise and escape some of its settings, which could allow high privilege users such as admin to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks even when the unfiltered_html capability is disallowed (for example in multisite setup).
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.
